objective: RRR GATE 1 V1: auditar exclusivamente mediante SQL canonico de solo lectura las estructuras reales existentes que puedan soportar Resena, Recompensa y Ranking antes de disenar cualquier DDL. Identificar fuentes canonicas y candidatos de reutilizacion para clientes/identidad, empresas/unidades, ventas/tickets, productos, CRM/contactos, usuarios/RBAC, campanas/comunicaciones/notificaciones, Cavas, auditoria/configuracion y cualquier objeto relacionado con loyalty, rewards, puntos, saldos, ledger, resenas, NPS, feedback, referidos, ranking, niveles, beneficios, segmentacion o marketing. Producir evidencia suficiente para una matriz REUSE / EXTEND / CREATE / DO_NOT_TOUCH. No modificar SQL, repositorio funcional, Worker, Supervisor, watchdog ni Produccion.
acceptance: inventario de objetos candidatos RRR con schema y tipo
columnas y tipos de objetos relevantes
PK, unique indexes e indices relevantes
identificar fuentes de ventas/tickets y claves de relacion con cliente/unidad/fecha_operacion
identificar estructuras de Cavas interoperables sin fusionar dominios
producir evidencia para clasificar cada capacidad como REUSE, EXTEND, CREATE o DO_NOT_TOUCH
no proponer DDL definitivo hasta cerrar y certificar la evidencia de este gate
constraints: no crear ni alterar tablas, columnas, vistas, indices, procedures, functions o triggers
no INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE TRUNCATE EXEC de procedimientos mutantes
no hardcodes de clientes, empresas, unidades, tiers, puntos o reglas
no tocar infraestructura del Universal Worker

queries.name: rrr_candidate_objects_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR o.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR o.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR o.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR o.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR o.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR o.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR o.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR o.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR o.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR o.name LIKE '%Config%' OR o.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR o.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR o.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR o.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR o.name LIKE '%Review%' OR o.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR o.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR o.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR o.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR o.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR o.name LIKE '%Segment%' OR o.name LIKE '%Marketing%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: rrr_candidate_table_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR t.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR t.name LIKE '%Config%' OR t.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR t.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR t.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Review%' OR t.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR t.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR t.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR t.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR t.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR t.name LIKE '%Segment%' OR t.name LIKE '%Marketing%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: rrr_candidate_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND i.is_hypothetical=0 AND (t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR t.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR t.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR t.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Review%' OR t.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR t.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR t.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR t.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR t.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR t.name LIKE '%Segment%' OR t.name LIKE '%Marketing%') ORDER BY t.name,i.is_primary_key DESC,i.is_unique DESC,i.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: rrr_candidate_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT ps.name AS parent_schema,pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rs.name AS referenced_schema,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE ps.name='dbo' AND (pt.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR pt.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Review%' OR pt.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Segment%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Marketing%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Usuario%') ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name,pc.name

queries.name: customer_identity_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,COUNT(*) AS total_columns,SUM(CASE WHEN c.name IN ('ClienteID','PersonaID','ContactoID','UsuarioID','EmpresaID','UnidadID','RFC','CURP','Email','Correo','Telefono','Movil','Nombre','RazonSocial','ExternalID','SourceID') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identity_signal_columns FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY identity_signal_columns DESC,total_columns DESC,t.name

queries.name: commercial_linkage_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comercial%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR c.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Operacion%' OR c.name LIKE '%Folio%' OR c.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR c.name LIKE '%Importe%' OR c.name LIKE '%Total%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: marketing_engagement_existing_structures
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Marketing%' OR t.name LIKE '%Segment%' OR t.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Review%' OR t.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR t.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR t.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR t.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR t.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR t.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR t.name LIKE '%Benef%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: rbac_audit_configuration_structures
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Capability%' OR t.name LIKE '%Policy%' OR t.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Config%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: cavas_interop_signals
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name LIKE '%Cava%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
